headline: Buster Blader
title: Buster Blader Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Buster Blader. What is it? It is a Level seven EARTH Warrior with two thousand six hundred attack. What does it do? It gains five hundred attack for each Dragon monster your opponent controls or has in their Graveyard. How do you use it? Side it in against Dragon decks. Against Blue-Eyes it can get huge very fast. It is in Duelist Pack: Yugi. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
